what: Verified P&L settings. Read by tools/record/price_lock.js (the price a model decision was made at) and tools/record/pnl_core.js (the stake it risks). docs/pnl/DESIGN.md
default_stake_note: Units RISKED by a graded pick whose source recorded no stake (the model's published number), once a real price is locked to it. Frozen on the row with the price: changing this affects only prices locked afterwards.

sources.what: ESPN sportsbook quotes the CFB Model Lab captures hourly before kickoff; append-only, written when a value changes and on a heartbeat (football/cfb_lab/lab_core.js dedupeDecision).

price_snapshots.max_age_note: The lab writes a quote when it changes and at least every 6 hours (HEARTBEAT_H), so a book's latest quote at or before the decision is its price then for 6 hours; past that the game went unobserved and the price is not vouched for.
price_snapshots.close_zone_note: Inside 3 hours of kickoff the lab writes at least every 50 minutes; a decision there takes a quote no older than the decision engine's own 90-minute limit (lib/edgedesk_decision.js freshness.max_quote_age_minutes).
